_doc: Every named shinobi of the beta (docs/RANKS.md). Names are rolled per save: text uses the name token, never the placeholder (given name first, family name last; a Hokage by given name only), which is for developers only. Clan members carry their clan's name; everyone else an ordinary family name from population.json that never matches a clan, and clan "none" says so. rank is each character's public rank when the player first sees them. levels are whole levels on the player's curve at the end of each stretch: adults hold theirs through the beta; the year's class and the squad a year ahead grow beside the player (grows: true; from life:roster's typical run, so guides, not fixed). tier is read from the level at first sight; clan_power from the clan. importance is the story's weight; spotlight is the writing and art budget. story: true marks a role docs/story/ owns: only its public rank and role live here. provisional: true marks a placeholder that waits for the story's cast. tools/roster/roster.py --check validates this file.

importance.story-driving: the story moves through them: the Hokage's circle, the senseis, your year and the squad ahead
importance.fan-favourite: they do not move the story, but players will look for them: showcase elites, proctors, the gate
importance.background: a face with a job and a rank

spotlight.pillar: few: a unique look and kit, a signature technique, showcase scenes
spotlight.named: their own lines and quests; a kit from the shared pool with one twist
spotlight.background: a rank, a role outfit, generated lines
spotlight.legend: spoken of, not met in the beta

class_clan_weights._doc: How a Varied save rolls the player's year (the eleven classmates): by clan group, then by population.json's weights inside the group, so familiar clans appear early. The village population is unchanged.

squad_clan_weights._doc: The same for the squad a year ahead and the five senseis: leaning noble, less than the class.
